note: Prefix of the model slug Cursor reports, mapped to the model family disensor declares. Cursor does not publish stable slugs: its models page lists display names, so this table is maintained by hand and is deliberately incomplete. A slug that matches nothing here stays UNMAPPED, and unmapped means nothing is prefilled. Inventing a family would make R4 validate a decorrelation that never happened.

deliberately_unmapped.auto: Cursor picks the model. The slug does not say which one ran, so the generator cannot be declared.
deliberately_unmapped.composer: Cursor's own models. They would collapse into 'other', where R4 cannot tell them apart from any other unmapped vendor.
deliberately_unmapped.grok: xAI has no family of its own in the schema enum. See the residue note in the README.
deliberately_unmapped.kimi: Moonshot has no family of its own in the schema enum.
deliberately_unmapped.glm: Z.ai has no family of its own in the schema enum.
deliberately_unmapped.muse: No family of its own in the schema enum.
